I train AI to think better.

With 3+ years of hands-on experience in RLHF and SFT evaluation, I specialize in building high-quality training data for Large Language Models - from rubric-based response ranking to red-teaming, PII annotation, and multilingual QA.

What makes me different:
→ Native fluency in Hindi, Hinglish & Marwari - rare in this field with English professionalism
→ 50+ SFT-standard prompts engineered across creative, analytical & generalist domains
→ 100+ paired AI responses evaluated with written alignment rationale
→ Consistent track record across multiple LLM training pipelines

Core Skills:
RLHF | SFT Evaluation | Preference Ranking | Prompt Engineering | LLM Alignment Feedback | PII Annotation | Bilingual QA | Red-Teaming | Translation QA | Audio Evaluation

📍 Delhi, India | Remote | Async | All Time Zones
